title: Runner Forge configuration
$comment: NO SECRET MAY EVER APPEAR IN THIS FILE. It holds only non-secret identifiers (app ids, installation ids, certificate *names*, Azure endpoint names). Every actual credential — private keys, passwords, client secrets, p12 blobs — lives in the OS keystore (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain) under the key names listed in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. A file that contains a secret is a bug, not a configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Config format version. Bumped only for breaking changes.

owner.description: GitHub user or organisation that owns the target repositories.

repos.description: Repository names (without the owner prefix) that these runners serve.

appId.description: GitHub App id. NOT a secret. The App's private key lives in the keystore under 'githubAppPrivateKey'.

installationId.description: Installation id of the GitHub App on the owner account. NOT a secret.

runners.description: One entry per runner class this machine should host.

classId.description: Runner class identifier. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 'Runner classes'.

replicas.description: Concurrent ephemeral runners of this class. Defaults differ per class: win-build 2, linux-util 1, mac-build 1, win-ilok 1 (fixed), mac-ilok 1 (fixed).

labels.description: Labels the ephemeral runner registers with. Must match the workflow's runs-on.

jobTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a drain waits for an in-flight job before force-stopping it.

allOf.$comment: iLok classes are host processes bound to one physical dongle. More than one is meaningless.
A Tart VM clone is heavy; two is the practical ceiling on one Mac.

mode.description: AAX signing strategy. 'cloud' needs no dongle; the iLok modes run a host-process runner on the machine holding the dongle.

paceAccount.description: PACE/iLok account name. The password lives in the keystore under 'pacePassword'.

paceWcGuid.description: PACE wrapping certificate GUID passed to wraptool as --wcguid.

paceSignId.description: PACE signing identifier passed to wraptool as --signid.

allowSigningService.description: Append --allowsigningservice to wraptool in 'cloud' mode. Requires an iLok Cloud enabled Eden tools licence.

provider.description: Authenticode signing for Windows binaries and the installer. Independent of AAX signing.

teamId.description: Apple Developer Team ID, e.g. ABCDE12345.

devIdAppIdentity.description: Certificate common name, e.g. 'Developer ID Application: Example Ltd (ABCDE12345)'. A name, not a key.

devIdInstallerIdentity.description: Certificate common name, e.g. 'Developer ID Installer: Example Ltd (ABCDE12345)'.

notarize.description: Run notarytool submit --wait and stapler staple after signing.

workDir.description: Root for job workspaces, caches, logs, state.json and proof/. Default C:\ProgramData\RunnerForge\work on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/RunnerForge/work on macOS.

aaxSdkSource.description: Local path to the Avid AAX SDK zip, or a private git URL. NEVER baked into an image layer; mounted from a local named volume at build time. Empty means AAX targets are skipped and the workflow emits an aax-skipped marker artifact.

keepBaseImages.description: Base Docker images are never purged. Rebuilding them costs tens of minutes.

keepTartImages.description: Tart images are never purged; only per-job clones are.

keepCaches.description: Keep the FetchContent/sccache/ccache named volumes between runs.

purgeOnExit.description: Run the Sweeper automatically when the app closes.

maxDiskGb.description: Free space preflight requires on the Docker data drive / Tart storage.

canaryRepo.description: owner/repo holding the canary plugin used for end-to-end self-test.

requiredGreenRuns.description: Consecutive green self-test runs required before the setup is considered stable.

lastProof.description: Written by SelfTestService after a self-test. null until the first run.

telemetry.description: Runner Forge sends no telemetry. The key exists so the absence is explicit and auditable.
